requirements.statement: Unknown signature custody faults the lane; restart requires fresh child proof and a replacement accepts an idempotent next claim exactly once.
Unknown billing custody faults the lane; later child proof settles once and the next probe succeeds after replacement.
An inconclusive probe tree is checked again without signalling a reaped root; only proven cleanup permits one settlement and a subsequent probe.
An account lane with unknown work is faulted, making restart due at the next check; status names held processes and the next action.
The collector restarts only after every account lane child is proven gone; retained signature pipes close after proof.
Account lane inconclusive-to-clear collector scenarios settle exactly once, return live probe counts to baseline and permit the next claim or probe.
An observation child reaped before cleanup cannot authorize signalling its former process group.
After three non-transient record failures a proven-ended probe settles as a denial; transient SQL failures remain retryable and later passes never duplicate settlement.
